channel.title: The Smithfield Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Smithfield Times (smithfieldtimes.com)

item.title: IW’s congressional district would lean Democratic under 10-1 redistricting map
item.description: A draft Virginia redistricting map would shift Isle of Wight’s congressional district Democratic, aiming to help the party win 10 of the state's 11 House of Representatives seats.

item.title: Letter – Surry official refutes critic
item.description: Surry Supervisor Walter Hardy Jr. disputes Robert Chandler’s claim he “demonized” him over Surry tax criticism, saying Chandler misquoted a recorded meeting.

item.title: Hundreds without power in IW, Surry; wind advisory in effect
item.description: Over 1,600 Dominion customers in Isle of Wight were without power as of early Saturday afternoon. The cause is under investigation. A National Weather Service advisory warns of wind gusts up to 50 mph through 9 p.m.

item.title: Letter – Hats off to utility workers
item.description: A Smithfield resident reminds readers that every restored light reflects the dangerous, exhausting work and sacrifice of utility crews who leave their own families to keep others powered.

item.title: Economics of Uncertainty: Load Management, Integrity Scandals, and Evolution of NBA Betting Markets in the 2026 Season
item.description: The 2025-2026 NBA season is a critical period of the symbiotic nature of professional sports and the controlled gambling business.

item.title: IWCS names divisionwide, school-level 2025-26 teachers of the year
item.description: Isle of Wight County Schools has named Windsor High’s Chris Johnson its 2025-26 divisionwide Teacher of the Year, along with eight school-level honorees across the division.

item.title: Letter – Newspaper came through
item.description: A subscriber praises Smithfield Times publisher Steve Stewart for rushing out a last-minute memorial cancellation notice.

item.title: Paying it forward: Free winter coats at Luter Sports Complex inspired by viral trend
item.description: Inspired by viral “Earl’s Fence” story, Smithfield volunteers hung dozens of free winter coats at Luter Sports Complex, quickly revealing a deep local need.

item.title: IW planners schedule Feb. 24 hearing on draft battery storage system ordinance
item.description: After several months of discussion, Isle of Wight planners set a Feb. 24 hearing on a draft ordinance allowing and regulating battery energy storage projects, including setbacks, noise limits and fire safety requirements.

item.title: Memoir reflects fondly on Battery Park upbringing
item.description: A memoir by William “Ed” Lowe II recalls his close-knit 1940s–50s childhood in Isle of Wight’s Battery Park, preserving memories of family, neighbors and river adventures for his descendants.
